body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'Surfaces 2009') -- <Visual News> Healthier Choice Flooring, manufacturer of premium carpet cushion and acoustical underlayment, announced the launch of its brand new consumer-focused website and also displayed its full product line at Surfaces 2009 in Las Vegas.
The website, www.healthierchoice.com, is designed to inform and educate flooring consumers to the benefits of Healthier Choice premium carpet cushions and underlayments.

The entire line, which includes premium products for residential, commercial and hospitality markets, offers unique performance, health and environmental benefits. Providing unrivaled performance all Healthier Choice carpet cushions and acoustical underlayments are also CRI Green Label certified and GREENGARD Indoor Air Quality Certified. Underlayments from Healthier Choice are made with renewable soy-based materials and contain Ultra-Fresh antimicrobial to prevent the growth of mold, mildew and bacteria. Healthier Choice products quality for multiple LEED credits as well.
